dishes.name: Pâté berrichon
dishes.desc: A pie of seasoned pork and veal in golden pastry, with whole hard-boiled eggs inside. Originally an Easter dish, now eaten year-round across the Berry.

dishes.name: Coq en barbouille
dishes.desc: Chicken braised with red wine, brandy and onions, then finished with a sauce thickened with the bird's blood and cream. A classic Berry dish.

dishes.name: Crottin de Chavignol
dishes.desc: A small goat cheese from the Sancerre hills in the Cher, creamy and mild when young, hard and sharp when aged. Often baked on salad.

dishes.name: Berry green lentils
dishes.desc: Small dark green lentils with protected geographical status, nutty and firm. Grown in the Berry and served with salt pork or in soups.

dishes.name: Forestines
dishes.desc: Hazelnut praline sweets in a crisp sugar shell, created in Bourges in 1879 by confectioner Georges Forest. Still made in the town.
